hints.textOnly: Only text is editable; timestamps stay locked to Whisper's output. Line breaks inside a cue are part of the subtitle and are kept.

confirm.discard: Your edits from this session will not be written to disk.
confirm.revert: This discards every edit you've made since opening the editor and restores the original subtitles from disk.

toast.noFormatsEnabled: All subtitle output formats are off in Settings. Enable at least one under "Settings → Subtitle output" before saving.
toast.lineLimit: A cue can hold at most {{count}} lines.
toast.reverted: Reverted to the version on disk

speakers.unavailable: This transcript has no speaker information. Turn on "Identify speakers" before transcribing, and keep the JSON output on.
speakers.title: Label speaker names
speakers.footnote: Speaker names are updated throughout this file. Transcribing again clears them, because the speaker numbers are worked out afresh.

empty.noFile: No transcript file found — maybe it hasn't been written yet.
empty.notFound: Transcript file not found. It may have been deleted or moved. Re-run the transcription on the Main tab to regenerate it.

autoOpen.label: Auto-open preview after transcription
autoOpen.description: Enable to automatically pop up the full-screen preview when each file finishes. Leave off for large batch runs.
